entities.summary: Nathan Anthony Richard Beaulieu is a Canadian former professional ice hockey defenceman. He was selected in the first round, 17th overall, by the Montreal Canadiens in the 2011 NHL entry draft. Beaulieu played in the National Hockey League (NHL) for the Canadiens, Buffalo Sabres, Winnipeg Jets, and Anaheim Ducks.
